sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include meropenem as of 2026-10-21.

Corvale General holds 425 vials at 15.2 vials per day, giving 27.9 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 29 vials at 2.6 vials per day, giving 11.2 days on hand.

Secondary options include WG Critical Care, LLC and ARMAS PHARMACEUTICALS INC, the latter supplied by Brooks Steriscience Limited last inspected VAI on 2024-11-12.
